parse.title: Illusionist (Betrayal)
parse.text:
Overview

Illusionist (Betrayal) is a MythicalMythical unit. He is only obtainable by evolving Illusionist .

Evolving

Illusionist (Betrayal) can be evolved from Illusionist with the following materials:

Required Items: x1 Illusionist
x1 Negation Box
x40 Soul Candy
Result
Illusionist (Betrayal)

He can be further evolved to Illusionist (Chrysalis) by acquiring 37.5% awakening (75 worthy souls) and 2,000 kills with him.

Why do I have different stats?
Units in this game use a randomized system, where stats like damage are randomly rolled with about a 10% variance (like Dungeon Quest items). When you evolve a unit they also reroll their stats, but it will always be strictly better than the pre-evolved version.

Active Attack: Illusionist: Illusion

Upon activation Illusionist will cast an illusion upon the enemies, making the base Invincible for 10 seconds. This ability is deemed very useful for leaderboard runs which is the main reason Illusionist is mainly used in leaderboard runs.

Selling

Units sell for 25% of their deployment cost and upgrades.

Trivia

  • At Update 11.5, his ability duration got nerfed from 20 seconds to 10 seconds.
